Common Resources Questions

Resources FAQ

Five things NE Ohio homeowners ask about the Roubic guides.

Are all the Roubic guides free?
Yes. Every guide on this page is free with no signup, no email wall, and no paywall. Roubic publishes them so homeowners can make better decisions on their tree work — regardless of whether they hire us.
Do you update the guides?
Yes — the Cost Guide and Removal Calculator get updated annually with confirmed pricing from Aaron's job records. The Species Guide, Storm Prep, and Arborist's Guide get updated when there are meaningful changes (new EAB spread patterns, new village permit rules, updated ANSI A300 revisions).
Which guide should I start with?
If you're comparing tree services or trying to budget: the Tree Service Cost Guide. If you have a specific tree and don't know what to do: When to Remove a Tree. If a storm just hit: Storm Prep & Safety.
Can I download PDF versions?
PDF downloads launch with the site — most guides have a "Download PDF" button at the top of the page for printable versions. The Storm Prep Checklist and Removal Cost Calculator are the most requested PDFs.
Do you have a checklist for storm prep?
Yes — the Storm Preparation & Tree Safety Guide includes a printable pre-storm canopy checklist Roubic uses on estate properties every February. Covers what to inspect, what to defer, and what constitutes an emergency after the storm hits.

Guides Are Great. On-Site Estimates Are Better.

Every Roubic estimate is free with an in-person property walk. No trip charge. Confirmed pricing before you book.
